definition: A system of administration run by many officials and rigid procedures.
sentence: Getting the permit meant weeks of bureaucracy.

definition: A system in which people or things are ranked one above another.
sentence: The company has a very flat hierarchy.

definition: A person who starts and runs a business, taking on financial risk.
sentence: The young entrepreneur opened three shops.

definition: An expert judge in matters of taste.
sentence: He is a connoisseur of old jazz recordings.

definition: A dark outline seen against a lighter background.
sentence: Her silhouette appeared in the doorway.

definition: A set of principles concerning beauty or artistic taste.
sentence: The building has a clean, modern aesthetic.

definition: A group or chain of islands.
sentence: They sailed through the northern archipelago.

definition: A spirit of friendly loyalty among a group.
sentence: The crew's camaraderie kept morale high.

definition: A sudden and widespread disaster.
sentence: The flood was a catastrophe for the valley.

definition: A garden plant with large, showy autumn blooms.
sentence: She planted a chrysanthemum by the gate.

definition: The final resolution of a story's plot.
sentence: The novel's denouement surprised everyone.

definition: Outstandingly bad; shocking.
sentence: That was an egregious error in judgment.

definition: A perfect example of a quality or type.
sentence: He is the epitome of patience.

definition: A mild word used in place of a harsh or blunt one.
sentence: Saying someone was let go is a euphemism for firing them.

definition: Treating a serious matter with inappropriate humor.
sentence: His facetious remark fell flat.

definition: Deliberate exaggeration not meant to be taken literally.
sentence: Saying he ate a ton is pure hyperbole.

definition: A peculiar habit belonging to one particular person.
sentence: Humming while he cooks is his one idiosyncrasy.

definition: A planned route or schedule for a journey.
sentence: She emailed the itinerary to everyone.

definition: A complicated network of winding passages.
sentence: The old city is a labyrinth of alleys.

definition: Calmly unconcerned.
sentence: He gave a nonchalant shrug.

definition: Miscellaneous equipment associated with an activity.
sentence: Fishing paraphernalia filled the garage.

definition: An exclusive right belonging to a person or group.
sentence: Changing her mind is her prerogative.

definition: Observation of an area to gather information, especially in warfare.
sentence: The team flew a reconnaissance mission at dawn.

definition: A meeting arranged at an agreed time and place.
sentence: They set a rendezvous at the old bridge.

definition: Close observation of a person or place.
sentence: The store keeps the lot under surveillance.
